crossRefs.note: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

people.name: Beno
people.line: Levite from the family of Merari

people.name: Jaaziah
people.line: Levite, descendant of Merari during David's reign.

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Mushi
people.line: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.
